statement: Fix D, P > 0. For all sufficiently large N and every integer 0 ≤ m ≤ N, there is a list Cm,N of rational subspaces of Rm, depending only on m, N, D, P, such that |Cm,N | ≤ 2N2ℓ−P . Every rational F ⊆ Rm with H(F) ≤ exp(NℓD) satisfies min U∈Cm,N d(F, U) ≤ Nℓ−P .
